jobs.title: SENIOR ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENTIST (SPECIALIST)
jobs.description:
Job Posting: Senior Environmental Scientist Banking Specialist

Department of Fish and Wildlife

JC-538652



Senior Environmental Scientist Banking Specialist
  
SENIOR ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENTIST (SPECIALIST)

$8,055.00 - $11,269.00 per Month
  
New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable.

**Final Filing Date:** **11/25/2026**

### **Job Description and Duties**

Are you passionate about conserving California’s fish and wildlife resources? Do you have the skills and drive to tackle environmental challenges? The California Department of Fish and Wildlife (CDFW) Habitat Conservation team is looking for a Senior Environmental Scientist (Specialist) to provide environmental review, permitting, and processing for mitigation banks and land packages across southern California.

  

You’ll manage a range of complex and impactful duties under the guidance of senior staff, and be responsible for:

* Conducting in-depth environmental reviews and analyses.
* Preparing Bank Agreements and Bank Enabling Instruments (Fish and Game Code 1793).
* Reviewing mitigation land packages, including real estate documents.
* Assessing development, restoration, and management plans for mitigation lands and banks.
* Preparing associated permits, such as Lake and Streambed Alteration Agreements, California Endangered Species Act (CESA) Incidental Take Permits (Fish and Game Code 2081b) and Consistency Determinations (Fish and Game Code 2080.1) and environmental reviews under California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA).

You will gather and review data on environmental, biological, and natural resource issues across Southern California, and help prepare draft regulatory and compliance documents, provide routine responses to public and regulated community inquiries, and assist in coordinating the permitting process.

  

This position requires someone who thrives in managing multiple projects simultaneously and ensures that tasks stay on schedule. If you’re looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity to make a meaningful impact, this could be the perfect fit for you!  
  
  

**Personal Leave Program:** Effective July 1, 2025, state employees are subject to temporary salary reductions ranging from 2% to 4.62% in exchange for Personal Leave Program (PLP) hours. Please note that the salary ranges listed in this Job Control may not reflect these reductions associated with the 2025 Personal Leave Program.

  

Please follow the link for more information regarding the 2025 Personal Leave program:

  

Personal Leave Program - Human Resources - CalHR.

This position may be eligible for a telework opportunity in accordance with departmental policies and operational needs. Beginning July 1, 2026, employees will be required to work in-person at least four (4) days per week in alignment with Executive Order N-22-25. Additional in-office days may be required based on operational needs.

Senior Environmental Scientist (Specialist): Exam Bulletin Link

**This position is a 12-month Limited Term (LT) and may be extended up to 24 months or become permanent.**

During this 12-month Limited Term assignment, you will receive full health, dental, and vision benefits! You will also earn State Service and accrue monthly leave credits.

You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**.

### **Working Conditions**

The position will be headquartered in the Ontario office, with site visits throughout the Inland Deserts Region, including Mono, Inyo, San Bernardino, Riverside, and Imperial Counties. The position requires the ability to drive state-owned vehicles for up to three or more hours each way and maintain a valid driver’s license, sometimes including early mornings and late nights or on consecutive days. Travel within the State up to 20% (one to three days in length) may also be required one to three times per year. The incumbent must be able to walk on uneven and hilly terrain for long distances (e.g., 10 miles or more), through wet and dry terrain, on and off trail. The position requires the ability to use a computer keyboard and Microsoft Office software for up to eight hours per day, and to complete office tasks that involve sitting, standing, and walking to other locations. The role also includes coordinating and participating in meetings and conference calls, as well as attending in-person meetings and working groups with stakeholders in addition to local, state, and federal departments and agencies, within the Inland Deserts Region. This position offers the possibility of an office centered-telework agreement based on the Department's current Telework Policy. The Position may require the incumbent to wear a uniform identifying the employee as CDFW staff.

  

### **Position Details**

**Job Code #:**

JC-538652

**Position #(s):**

565-603-0765-905

**Working Title:**

**Senior Environmental Scientist Banking Specialist**

**Classification:**

SENIOR ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENTIST (SPECIALIST)

$8,055.00 - $11,269.00

New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable.

**# of Positions:**

1

**Work Location:**

San Bernardino County

**Telework:**

Hybrid

**Job Type:**

12 Month Limited Term - Full Time

### **Department Information**

Department of Fish and Wildlife (CDFW) employees are committed to managing and protecting California’s diverse wildlife and the habitats upon which they depend.

  

California is one of the most biodiverse places on the planet. As such, CDFW values diverse employees working together to protect nature for all Californians. CDFW is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment where all backgrounds, cultures and personal experiences can thrive and connect others to our critical mission.

  

Join us and begin a meaningful new career!

DTSC is hiring a supervisor in the Chatsworth Office to oversee a team in the Enforcement and Emergency Response Division (EERD). jobs.title: Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS II) – Toxicology
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

As a Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS II) – Toxicology, you’ll perform and evaluate laboratory testing that supports the detection and interpretation of toxicology findings. You’ll handle specimens, operate laboratory equipment, maintain accurate records, and follow established procedures and quality controls. Your impact: Reliable test results help clinicians make informed decisions about patient care.

**Responsibilities**

* Collect or receive, identify, prepare, and process specimens using appropriate blood sampling, venipuncture, and aseptic techniques.
* Perform toxicology assays and relevant clinical chemistry testing; operate, maintain, and troubleshoot medical laboratory equipment.
* Review results, apply diagnostic test interpretation, and escalate unexpected findings according to laboratory procedures.
* Document testing and quality-control activities in laboratory information systems (LIS) and laboratory information management systems (LIMS).
* Follow Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations, safety requirements, and laboratory quality-control protocols.

**Skills**

* **Essential:** Medical laboratory work experience and clinical laboratory experience; knowledge of laboratory procedures, tests, techniques, data management, and data analysis.
* **Essential:** Familiarity with immunoassays, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), polymerase chain reaction (PCR), and specimen collection and processing.
* **Preferred:** Experience with RNA extraction, DNA isolation, flow cytometry, clinical trials, or research laboratory work.
* **Preferred:** Exposure to laboratory management, blood banking, hematology, microbiology testing, cytotechnology, or hospital experience.
* Knowledge of anatomy, physiology, medical terminology, vital signs, computed tomography (CT), and medical equipment operation is also relevant.

Pay: $45.00 - $50.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Environmental Data Validation Chemist
jobs.description:
**Environmental Data Validation Chemist (Part-Time, Remote)**

**Location:** Remote (U.S.-based). Not open to residents of California, Colorado, Illinois, North Dakota, Ohio, Washington, or Wyoming.

**Schedule:** Part-time, approximately 20–29 hours per week, W-2 hourly

**Experience:** 5+ years of regulatory data validation

**About Impact Environmental**

Since 1989, Impact Environmental has carried projects from site assessment through regulatory closure under NYSDEC, NJDEP, and USEPA programs. Our decisions in the field and in our reports are only as defensible as the data underneath them.

**The Role**

We are bringing data validation in-house. You will validate laboratory data and prepare Data Usability Summary Reports (DUSRs) and validation reports for our NYSDEC, NJDEP LSRP, and USEPA projects. You set your own hours around agreed turnaround times. To keep validation independent, you will not serve on the field or reporting team for projects you validate.

**What You Will Do**

· Validate soil, groundwater, soil vapor, air, and waste characterization data and prepare DUSRs under NYSDEC DER-10 Appendix 2B, NJDEP data usability guidance (N.J.A.C. 7:26E), USEPA National Functional Guidelines, and project QAPPs.

· Perform Stage 2A through Stage 4 validation as the program and QAPP require. Stage 2B is most common on our projects.

· Cover SW-846 methods (8260D, 8270E incl. 1,4-dioxane SIM, 8081B, 8082A, 6010D/6020B, 7471B, 9012B, 7196A), PFAS by EPA 1633, and TO-15 vapor and air data, including canister QC.

· Apply qualifiers with documented rationale and translate results into clear usability conclusions for project managers.

· Add validation qualifiers to NYSDEC EQuIS EDDs, run them through the EQuIS Data Processor, and prepare NJDEP EDDs where required.

· Work with laboratories to resolve discrepancies and obtain corrected deliverables.

**What You Bring**

· Bachelor’s degree in chemistry or a related science.

· 5+ years of environmental data validation, including DUSRs or validation reports accepted by a state or federal agency. Redacted work samples may be requested.

· Hands-on experience with both limited (Stage 2A/2B) and full (Stage 3/4) validation.

· Experience validating PFAS data by EPA Method 1633.

· Independence from the laboratories whose data you review, as DER-10 requires.

· Clear writing and the ability to explain data quality to non-chemists.

· Ability to work independently, protect client data, and disclose any outside validation or consulting work.

**Preferred**

· DUSRs accepted by NYSDEC on Brownfield Cleanup Program sites.

· UFP-QAPP projects, EQuIS EDD submittals, or automated data review tools.

· Laboratory bench experience (GC/MS, GC/ECD, ICP, LC-MS/MS).

**Compensation and Benefits**

$40.00 – $60.00 per hour, based on validation experience and regulatory program and method coverage (including PFAS). This part-time position is not eligible for health and welfare benefits. Paid sick leave will be provided in accordance with applicable state and local law. Eligibility for the 401(k) retirement plan will be determined in accordance with the terms of the plan.

**How to Apply**

Apply through this posting with a current resume. Note the programs (NYSDEC, NJDEP, USEPA), methods, and validation stages you have performed. Cover letters are optional.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Impact Environmental is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Reasonable accommodations are available on request.

**Work Location:** Remote (U.S.-based; excludes CA, CO, IL, ND, OH, WA, WY)

Pay: $40.00 - $60.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote
